scenario_type: independent conditional assumptions, not company guidance or consensus
scope: Broad physical AI infrastructure annual investment envelope. Component and upstream supplier revenues are different transaction layers and must not be summed into final demand.
calibration_2026_status: Rounded modelling anchor from Gartner's nearly USD1trillion expectation; not a measured full-year result.

rationale.weak: Financing/power constraints and investment pause; nominal 2029 spending falls from 2028 despite continued AI usage growth.
rationale.base: Continued buildout with slower growth and partial normalization of equipment mix/pricing. Not an automatic full realization of every supplier's bullish outlook.
rationale.strong: Faster monetization, power delivery and supplier expansion; high spending together with favorable company share and margins is a joint upside case, not a confidence bound.

external_anchors.warning: Cumulative 2027-2030 is not annual spending. The article also warns of funding/ROIC/write-down risk; it does not promise supplier profits.

Narrower server/storage vendor-spending scope; do not add to Gartner infrastructure envelope. 1080/1700~64% is a scale sanity check, not a verified allocation ratio or formal reconciliation of the two taxonomies.
Company view; capex may include non-AI, and FY2028 is approximately calendar2027, not calendar2028. Explicit benchmark to test the independent 2028 model, not an extra spending line to add.

valuation.terminal_pe_status: Independent assumptions specified before model outputs, not measured fair-value multiples. Check same-PER, +/-25% PE and discount-rate sensitivities.
valuation.price_vs_eps_definition: Oct16 share price divided by each future scenario's annual normalized EPS; neither observed current TTM PE nor published consensus forward PE.
valuation.present_value_definition: Future annual normalized EPS times assumed terminal PE discounted from target date; conditional entry-price equivalent excluding dividends/tax/FX changes, not a full cash-flow DCF or market price target.
